entry.name: icon
entry.label: The name of the icon used in the compact representation (e.g. on a small panel).

entry.name: menuLabel
entry.label: Text label for the Panel button

entry.name: favorites
entry.label: List of general favorites. Supported values are menu id's (usually .desktop file names), special URLs that expand into default applications (e.g. preferred://browser), document URLs and KPeople contact URIs.

entry.name: systemFavorites
entry.label: List of system action favorites shown as icon buttons next to the Leave menu.

entry.name: rememberLastPage
entry.label: Reopen the menu on the last used tab and category

entry.name: lastTab
entry.label: Last used tab (0 Home, 1 Apps, 2 Places, 3 Info)

entry.name: lastCategoryRow
entry.label: Last selected category row in the Apps sidebar (-1 = none)

entry.name: gadgetColumns
entry.label: Number of columns in the Info gadget grid (2-4)

entry.name: gadgetLayout
entry.label: JSON: ordered list of gadget instances, sizes and per-gadget settings

entry.name: gadgetCache
entry.label: JSON: cached online data (weather, currency, feeds, scores) with timestamps

entry.name: primaryActions
entry.label: Which actions should be displayed in the footer: 0 = Power, 1 = Session, 2 = Custom, 3 = Power and session

entry.name: favoritesPortedToKAstats
entry.label: Are the favorites ported to use KActivitiesStats to allow per-activity favorites

entry.name: systemApplications
entry.label: List of applications at the top of the "Computer" tab.

entry.name: paneSwap
entry.label: Whether to swap the sidebar and content panes

entry.name: favoritesDisplay
entry.label: How to display favorites: 0 = Grid, 1 = List

entry.name: applicationsDisplay
entry.label: How to display applications: 0 = Grid, 1 = List

entry.name: alphaSort
entry.label: Whether to sort menu contents alphabetically or use manual/system sort order.

entry.name: pin
entry.label: Whether the popup should remain open when another window is activated

entry.name: showActionButtonCaptions
entry.label: Whether to display captions ("shut down", "log out", etc.) for the header action buttons

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Whether to use a compact display style for list items

entry.name: useSymbolicIcons
entry.label: Whether to use symbolic icons instead of colored ones

entry.name: showAllApplications
entry.label: Whether to show the "All Applications" category in the sidebar

entry.name: showSmartSection
entry.label: Show AI-suggested apps section on the home page

entry.name: showRecentSection
entry.label: Show recently used apps section on the home page

entry.name: showFrequentSection
entry.label: Show frequently used apps section on the home page

entry.name: showPlacesTab
entry.label: Show Places tab in the footer

entry.name: onboardingCompleted
entry.label: Whether the first-run experience has been completed

entry.name: highContrastMode
entry.label: Force high contrast for all text elements

entry.name: largeTextMode
entry.label: Increase text sizes for readability

entry.name: searchShowCategories
entry.label: Group search results by category

entry.name: showRecentFiles
entry.label: Show recently opened files on the home page

entry.name: showRecentFolders
entry.label: Show recently used folders on the home page

entry.name: recentAppsMax
entry.label: Maximum number of recent apps to show

entry.name: recentFilesMax
entry.label: Maximum number of recent files to show

entry.name: recentFoldersMax
entry.label: Maximum number of recent folders to show

entry.name: infoShowSystemInfo
entry.label: Show system information widget (hostname, kernel, shell, etc.)

entry.name: infoShowHardwareMonitor
entry.label: Show hardware monitor widget (CPU, RAM, SWAP, Disk)

entry.name: infoShowCalendar
entry.label: Show calendar widget

entry.name: infoShowWeather
entry.label: Show weather widget

entry.name: infoShowQuickLinks
entry.label: Show quick links widget

entry.name: infoShowNews
entry.label: Show news RSS feed widget
